Private Function Made(ws As Worksheet, ByVal which As Long, ByVal target As Boolean) As Object
    Dim c As Object
    If target Then
        Select Case which
        Case 0: Set c = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 96, 240, 144).Chart: c.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3")
        Case 1: Set c = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered, 48, 96, 240, 144).Chart: c.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3")
        Case 2: Set c = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 96, 240, 144).Chart: c.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
        End Select
    Else
        Select Case which
        Case 0: Set c = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(227, xlLine, 320, 96, 240, 144).Chart: c.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3")
        Case 1: Set c = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered, 320, 96, 240, 144).Chart: c.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3")
        Case 2: Set c = ws.ChartObjects.Add(320, 96, 240, 144).Chart: c.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3")
        Case 3: Set c = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered, 320, 96, 240, 144).Chart: c.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3"): c.HasTitle = True: c.ChartTitle.Text = "T": c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255
        End Select
    End If
    Set Made = c
End Function

Private Function Book() As Workbook
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Name = "One"
    ws.Range("A1:C1").Value = Array("", "Rev", "Cost")
    ws.Range("A2:C2").Value = Array("a", 10, 4)
    ws.Range("A3:C3").Value = Array("b", 20, 6)
    ws.Range("A4:C4").Value = Array("c", 30, 8)
    Set Book = wb
End Function

Public Function MakeTemplate(ByVal which As Long, ByVal t As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Set wb = Book()
    Made(wb.Worksheets(1), which, False).SaveChartTemplate t
    wb.Close False
    MakeTemplate = CStr(Dir(t) <> "")
End Function

Public Function Apply(ByVal out As String, ByVal which As Long, ByVal t As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, c As Object, s As String
    Set wb = Book()
    Set c = Made(wb.Worksheets(1), which, True)
    On Error Resume Next
    c.ApplyChartTemplate t
    s = Err.Number & " " & c.ChartType & " " & c.SeriesCollection.Count
    On Error GoTo 0
    wb.SaveAs out, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Apply = s
End Function
